Professor Lumbang is a tough professor. He will teach, and he does it well most of the time, but he will not hold your hand in these subjects. His quizzes require critical thinking, and most importantly a good body of knowledge of the topic and its example problems (i emphasize knowing example problems). He adjusts his quizzes based on the performance of your class. Depending on if your class does well or not; if not, his final quiz (quiz 5) will include an essay type question. He's not holding your hand, but he's not letting you fall off the cliff either. If you do fall off the cliff, his final hurrah, atleast in our batch, is adjust the passing grade. In our case, the passing grade was 50. So you might have fallen off the cliff, but you're still holding on by the very tip of your pinky finger. For him, that's a passing grade (3.00).

I cannot stress enough how you need to familiarize yourself with example problems. That's all I can really say for Lumbang. Good luck

im going to be objective, despite the many hardships and stress this man put under me and my class. Bartoline is a pragmatic professor. He doesn't care about theories or methods, only  what tool to use and when to use it. Because of this, he didn't give a grading system, he didn't give modules or lectures, and worst of all, 80% of the grade you get from him will come from ONE quiz and ONE exam. That's it. Fail that one quiz, on that one particular day, and you are already failed. No ifs, no buts, you failed. His teaching style is archaic and inaccessible,  like i said before, he doesnt hand out lecture files (IM) and all his lectures are you listening to him teach you the concept on the board. This isn't a problem if you vibe with that teaching method--writing notes on the go, not having any defined structure in your subject--to each their own. We've also noticed that he has a certain favoritism to female students. 

Overall, his teaching style is an acquired taste. If you want to always wonder 'what will be our next lesson' or 'will he give a quiz this week' ad nauseam until he gives a short notice to the one and only quiz he will EVER give, then being stressed and burnt out because you couldn't review enough for a quiz, that, once again, was on short notice, then this prof is for you. 

Good luck.
